notes.title: TITAN HUNTER Release
notes.content:
[h1] Updated combat system: [/h1]
For all types of weapons, rate of fire and flight path were adjusted when firing.
Bullets now do damage depending on the characteristics of the monster.
Recharging is much faster.
Each weapon now has its own characteristics: dispersion, reload speed, rate of fire.

[h1] A number of improvements have been made for monsters: [/h1]
Now each monster appears with its own personal characteristics.
Each monster has its own unique health system.

[h1] Fixed boss statistics: [/h1]
For some bosses, it was decided to reduce the maximum amount of health.
And the bosses on the 2nd and 4th floors changed their plan of attack.
Fixed bug with the boss getting stuck on the 3rd floor.

On each floor 1-4, 10 new rooms were added.
An error was fixed in the tavern, due to which the slot machine did not work.
